In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nd, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Nd and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nd, and one P atom.
